description: Broadcast a signed raw transaction to the network. Takes a hex-encoded signed transaction and submits it to the local node, which relays it to the network. Returns the transaction hash (txid) on success. This is the companion to definecurrency — definecurrency returns a signed hex that must be broadcast here. Also used for any pre-signed transaction hex.

allowhighfees.description: Allow transactions with unusually high fees. Default: false.

name: sendrawtransaction
